name: Berith
source:
A high-ranking demon normally beyond human summoning, Berith is one of Alma’s trusted subordinates.
Called forth to support Alma, he hides a complex agenda. Upon first meeting the heroine, he bluntly declares his hatred for her.

“I despise your ugly ambition.”

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/gakereijou/character/]the official website[/url].]
